ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The large title in the upper left of the image says “Soil Profile”. The explanatory text on the left mentions “Texturally distinct layers or horizons” and “Different for every area”. The image also shows the vertical layering of soil, labeled with soil horizons such as O, A, B, C, and includes labels such as humus, topsoil, subsoil, weathered parent material, and bedrock. Reasoning: The title and the labels of each layer all indicate that this is explaining the layered structure of soil from the ground surface to the parent material/bedrock, therefore the image represents a soil profile.
